checkpoints.title: RPS-001 — Build and Verify a Round
Individual Review 4 — Improve and hand off
Group Review 4 — Improve and hand off

classes.label: Wed Nov 4 · Finish the posted RPS-001 task
classes.bring: Your RPS repository, SPEC, code, tests and actual results.
classes.work: Run the real round and full checks; inspect the diff and prepare the reviewed PR.
classes.review: Explain one test and the mistake it would catch. Try replay and keyboard controls.
classes.update: Keep the posted scope; link real issue, PR and CI results in SPEC.
classes.note: RPS-001 is due at 11:59 p.m., not before this class. Future targets are planned until Canvas posts them.

classes.label: Fri Nov 6 · Plan the two projects
classes.bring: Current RPS work, a creative direction, and one group business task.
classes.work: Introduce scope/spec and a supported accounts/session approach for the planned next Studio.
classes.review: Can a classmate explain your intended user and compare two feasible approaches?
classes.update: Use one individual spec by default for RPS and creative work; agree group owners/reviewers.
classes.note: These are planned future reviews. Confirm current teams and Canvas instructions before submitting.

classes.label: Wed Nov 11 · Plan workshop and peer questions
classes.bring: Two small approaches, three to five stories/checks, and group responsibilities.
classes.work: Revise plans; practice the bounded RPS skill in the same app.
classes.review: Question one assumption and one acceptance check; record the issue and response.
classes.update: Keep the chosen scope and rejected option in the existing record.

classes.label: Fri Nov 13 · Review 1 target; start a working slice
classes.bring: The two current specs and a small path to implement.
classes.work: Use plans to build the first real path. Continue supported accounts/session work.
classes.review: Check whether the expected result is independent of the code or AI claim.
classes.update: Link the current source and a real success/failure check.

classes.label: Wed Nov 18 · Build workshop and cross-review
classes.bring: A working slice, the current tests, and one task for a reviewer.
classes.work: Implement and integrate small pieces; partners review each other’s work.
classes.review: Try a real task without coaching; give a specific strength and obstacle.
classes.update: Record actual observations, response, change and checks.

classes.label: Fri Nov 20 · Review 2 target; integrate the build
classes.bring: Current individual/group slices and focused RPS-002 evidence.
classes.work: Combine required pieces. Introduce planned dashboard/integration work and final-review expectations.
classes.review: Name the most useful failure or uncertainty to investigate next.
classes.update: Link focused Studio checks from the same project record; label unfinished work.
classes.note: Final-review expectations are explained now, before recess. No new topic starts in the protected finish week.

classes.label: Wed Nov 25 · Integration and review workshop
classes.bring: Integrated paths, setup instructions, and a task for each project.
classes.work: Combine and inspect the workflows; choose one meaningful feedback issue to fix.
classes.review: A peer runs a task and explains the result/status in their own words.
classes.update: Keep the current revision, observed problem and retest plan in the same record.
classes.note: Friday conversion day: Section 001 meets Wednesday November 25 at its usual Friday time.

classes.label: Wed Dec 2 · Build snapshot; protected finishing work
classes.bring: Review 3 build links, current RPS integration and unresolved issues.
classes.work: Capture the build snapshot, then repair, complete missed peer reviews and rehearse. No new topic.
classes.review: Observe a real task; choose a meaningful change and check it again.
classes.update: Keep the same URLs and source record through the final-ready target.
classes.note: Planned build target after the holiday. This does not add a new report or restart the project.

classes.label: Fri Dec 4 · Protected reviews and rehearsal
classes.bring: All working projects, issue responses, final links and actual contribution notes.
classes.work: Finish integration, missed reviews and repairs; rehearse concise explanations.
classes.review: Have a peer try the changed task again; verify the result and remaining limits.
classes.update: Finalize the existing records and links. No new feature area.

classes.label: Sun Dec 6 · Planned final-ready target — no class
classes.bring: The selected versions, existing records and final source revisions.
classes.work: No Sunday class is scheduled. This is the proposed final-ready cutoff.
classes.review: Include actual feedback/change/retest evidence; do not invent a missing check.
classes.update: Keep the same working links for the proposed class demos.
classes.note: Planned until posted in Canvas; 11:59 p.m. Eastern.

classes.label: Wed Dec 9 · Planned regular-class Demo Day
classes.bring: Your assigned time if announced, both projects, source/spec and evidence.
classes.work: Demonstrate if scheduled; give useful feedback on classmates’ work.
classes.review: Explain your contribution, one choice, a check and a meaningful improvement.
classes.update: Keep the same URLs and follow actual instructor feedback.
classes.note: Regular-class demo dates are planned; Canvas will confirm slots, duration and delivery details.

classes.label: Fri Dec 11 · Planned regular-class Demo Day
classes.bring: Your assigned time if announced, both projects, source/spec and evidence.
classes.work: Demonstrate if scheduled; give useful feedback on classmates’ work.
classes.review: Explain your contribution, one choice, a check and a meaningful improvement.
classes.update: Keep the same URLs and follow actual instructor feedback.
classes.note: Regular-class demo dates are planned; Canvas will confirm slots, duration and delivery details.

classes.label: Wed Dec 16 · Announced final / redo block
classes.bring: Confirmed presentation instructions and working project links.
classes.work: Remaining presentations and needed redos, 2:30–5 p.m. Eastern.
classes.review: Explain actual work and evidence; identify limits.
classes.update: Follow the instructor’s confirmed final arrangements.
classes.note: Both sections share the announced block. Canvas says Zoom; Registrar lists FMH 408. Delivery details must be confirmed.
